author: Ramp
text: 2d On Friday, Ramp submitted an application to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish Ramp National Trust Bank. If approved, the charter would allow the trust bank to offer fiduciary investment management and custody of digital assets. The proposed trust bank would bring these services under a consistent federal regulatory framework, helping us build great products alongside our banking partners to further our mission to save businesses time and money. It will not take deposits or make commercial loans. 913 9 Comments Like Comment Share Jordan Wise 2d A federal trust charter for custody of digital assets feels like the measured way for this space to grow up, with real oversight instead of hype. If businesses can hold and manage those assets inside the same platform they already use for spend, adoption will likely come from finance teams, not traders. Curious whether Ramp sees treasury use cases leading here, or payments. Like Reply Ernestina M Stanley 2d A significant and exciting step for Ramp! As the company continues to expand beyond spend management into broader financial services, pursuing a national trust bank charter signals a strategic evolution. What stands out is the opportunity to balance innovation in digital assets with strong regulatory oversight, governance, and risk management. Building that foundation will be essential to driving sustainable growth and customer trust. Looking forward to seeing how this develops! Like Reply 1 Reaction
